title: Ather 450X Gen 3 Pro Apex (Track Edition)
description: Representing Ather Energy's prowess in the Urban Electric Scooter class, the Ather Energy Ather 450X Gen 3 Pro Apex (Track Edition) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. A 450cc powerplant pumps out 44 HP and 38 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
